messages.text:
I can't skip the confirmation card or mark staff approval as granted, even for a manager's own order. Every refund needs two separate decisions: you confirm with the button on the proposal card, and a staff member approves it (refund-policy/v2/approval).

I've created a proposal for the Wireless gaming keyboard (order h63-o1). The shop's records show the keyboard was received back (refund-policy/v2/return). The refund is 124.99 BRL (refund-policy/v2/amount).

Please press the confirm button on the proposal card. After a staff member approves it, I can complete the payment and give you the receipt.
